project: Ouwen (欧闻) — Hainan Foreigner Daily Guide
description: Bilingual (EN primary + 中文) daily content calendar covering the 4 stages of a foreigner's Hainan journey. Each entry = pain point → Ouwen solution → authoritative official source.

calendar.title: Do I even need a visa? 61 countries don't.
calendar.title_cn: 我需要签证吗？61 个国家不需要
calendar.pain: Uncertain which visa type applies and how long it takes.
calendar.pain_cn: 不确定适用哪种签证类型，也不清楚需要多长时间。
calendar.solution: 61 countries enter Hainan visa-free for 30 days (tourism, business, visits, family, medical treatment, exhibitions, sports). For work use Z, study X1/X2, family Q1/Q2.
calendar.solution_cn: 61 国人员免签入境 30 天（旅游/商贸/访问/探亲/就医/会展/体育竞技）。工作用 Z 签，学习用 X1/X2，家庭团聚用 Q1/Q2。

source.name: Hainan FTP International Service Portal
source.name_cn: 海南自贸港国际服务门户

highlights.en: 61 countries can enter Hainan visa-free under the regional visa-free policy (updated Aug 20, 2026).
highlights.cn: 61 国人员可依区域性免签政策免签入境海南（2026-08-20 更新）。

highlights.en: Allowed purposes: tourism, business, visits, family, medical treatment, exhibitions, sports competitions (work and study excluded).
highlights.cn: 适用事由：旅游、商贸、访问、探亲、就医、会展、体育竞技（不含工作和学习）。

highlights.en: Activity is limited to Hainan Province, up to 30 days.
highlights.cn: 活动范围仅限于海南省行政区域，停留不超过 30 天。

facts.cn: 61 个免签国家（截至 2026 年 8 月）

facts.en: Entry via any Hainan open port
facts.cn: 经海南省任一对外开放口岸入境

tip.en: Your stay counts from 00:00 on the day AFTER arrival. If you plan to travel to the mainland or extend your stay, apply for a permit before your visa-free period expires.
tip.cn: 停留时间自入境次日 0 时起算。若要前往内地或延长停留，须在免签到期前向公安出入境管理部门申请许可。

official_links.label_cn: 国家移民管理局——61 国海南免签政策

calendar.title: The Z-visa document checklist, decoded.
calendar.title_cn: Z 字签证材料清单，逐条拆解
calendar.pain: Application materials feel complicated and unclear.
calendar.pain_cn: 申请材料繁琐、要求不清晰。
calendar.solution: One-window service: work permit + residence permit together. We give you a standardised checklist and track progress.
calendar.solution_cn: 「一窗通办」：工作许可与居留许可一起办。我们提供标准化清单并全程跟踪进度。

highlights.en: Hainan runs a 'one-window service' — work permit and residence permit are processed together in a single application.
highlights.cn: 海南实行「一窗通办」——工作许可与居留许可一次性合并办理。

highlights.en: A standardised document checklist removes guesswork from the Z-visa application.
highlights.cn: 标准化材料清单，让 Z 字签证申请不再靠猜。

highlights.en: Progress is tracked end-to-end so you always know the current status.
highlights.cn: 全程跟踪进度，随时掌握办理状态。

facts.cn: 工作许可 + 居留许可一窗办理

tip.en: Prepare scanned colour copies of your passport, degree certificate (authenticated), and a clean criminal record check before starting — these are the most common delay points.
tip.cn: 提前备好护照彩色扫描件、学历证书（认证件）和无犯罪记录证明——这三样是最常见的拖进度环节。

calendar.title: Where do I stay before I find 'home'?
calendar.title_cn: 在找到「家」之前，我住哪里？
calendar.pain: Hard to find short/long-term housing suited to foreigners from abroad.
calendar.pain_cn: 人在境外，很难找到适合外国人的短期/长期住房。
calendar.solution: 'Arrival Package': airport pickup, transitional housing at partner hotels/apartments, initial essentials setup.
calendar.solution_cn: 「安心抵达套餐」：接机、合作酒店/公寓过渡住宿、初期生活用品配置。

source.name: en.hainan.gov.cn — Living services
source.name_cn: 海南政府网 — 生活服务

highlights.en: An 'Arrival Package' covers airport pickup before you even step out of the terminal.
highlights.cn: 「安心抵达套餐」在你出航站楼前就安排好接机。

highlights.en: Transitional housing at partner hotels and serviced apartments lets you settle in while you hunt for a long-term home.
highlights.cn: 合作酒店与酒店式公寓的过渡住宿，让你在找长期住房期间先安顿下来。

highlights.en: Initial essentials setup (SIM, transport, utilities) is handled for you.
highlights.cn: 初期生活配置（电话卡、交通、水电）一并代办。

facts.cn: 接机 + 过渡住宿 + 生活配置

tip.en: Book your first 1–2 weeks of accommodation before you fly — this gives you a registered address, which you need for accommodation registration and many later steps.
tip.cn: 起飞前先订好前 1–2 周住宿——有了登记地址，后续的住宿登记和多项手续才好办。

calendar.title: Pre-load e-CNY before you even land.
calendar.title_cn: 落地前就预充值数字人民币
calendar.pain: Worried about paying on arrival; unsure how to exchange money or open accounts.
calendar.pain_cn: 担心抵达时无法支付；不确定如何兑换货币或开户。
calendar.solution: Pre-charge a digital-yuan (e-CNY) wallet from abroad — 210+ countries register by phone, anonymous wallet, no Chinese bank card needed.
calendar.solution_cn: 从境外预充值数字人民币钱包——支持 210+ 国家手机号注册、匿名钱包、无需境内银行卡。

source.name: PBOC — e-CNY for inbound visitors
source.name_cn: 人民银行 — 入境旅客数字人民币

highlights.en: You can pre-charge an e-CNY (digital yuan) wallet from abroad before you land.
highlights.cn: 可在境外提前预充值数字人民币（e-CNY）钱包，落地即用。

highlights.en: Registration works with a foreign phone number — 210+ countries are supported.
highlights.cn: 支持境外手机号注册，覆盖 210+ 个国家/地区。

highlights.en: An anonymous wallet is available, and no Chinese bank card is required to get started.
highlights.cn: 提供匿名钱包，无需境内银行卡即可开通。

facts.cn: 支持 210+ 国家/地区手机号注册

facts.en: 0 Chinese bank card needed to start

tip.en: Download the e-CNY app and register with your home-country number while you still have stable internet — it is far smoother than doing it on arrival.
tip.cn: 趁网络稳定时，用本国手机号下载并注册数字人民币 App，比落地后再弄顺畅得多。

official_links.label_cn: 人民银行——入境旅客数字人民币

calendar.title: Visa, Mastercard, JCB — now work on WeChat & Alipay.
calendar.title_cn: Visa、Mastercard、JCB——微信支付宝都能用了
calendar.pain: Fear that only Chinese bank cards are accepted.
calendar.pain_cn: 担心只接受中国银行卡。
calendar.solution: WeChat Pay & Alipay accept Visa / Mastercard / JCB / Amex / Discover. Foreign phone numbers supported.
calendar.solution_cn: 微信支付与支付宝支持 Visa/Mastercard/JCB/Amex/Discover，并支持境外手机号。

source.name: PBOC — Payment Guide for Foreigners
source.name_cn: 人民银行 — 外籍来华支付指南

highlights.en: WeChat Pay and Alipay accept international cards: Visa, Mastercard, JCB, Amex and Discover.
highlights.cn: 微信支付与支付宝支持 Visa、Mastercard、JCB、Amex、Discover 国际卡。

highlights.en: Foreign phone numbers are fully supported for account binding.
highlights.cn: 完全支持境外手机号绑定。

highlights.en: This removes the biggest day-one worry for inbound visitors: paying with your own card.
highlights.cn: 解决了入境旅客落地第一天的最大顾虑——用自己的卡就能付。

facts.cn: 支持 5 大国际卡组织
两大支付：微信支付 + 支付宝

tip.en: Link your card BEFORE you fly and do one small test transaction — a declined overseas card is almost always a bank-side security block you can clear with a quick call.
tip.cn: 起飞前先绑卡并做一笔小额测试——境外卡被拒大多是发卡行的风控拦截，一通电话即可解除。

official_links.label_cn: 人民银行——外籍来华支付指南

calendar.title: The language barrier starts before takeoff.
calendar.title_cn: 语言障碍，从起飞前就开始了
calendar.pain: Worried about communicating in Chinese upon arrival.
calendar.pain_cn: 担心抵达后无法用中文沟通。
calendar.solution: 12345 hotline serves EN / RU / JA / KO; bilingual signage is mandated at airports and transport hubs.
calendar.solution_cn: 12345 热线提供英/俄/日/韩服务；机场及交通枢纽强制设置双语标识。

highlights.en: The 12345 government service hotline answers in English, Russian, Japanese and Korean.
highlights.cn: 12345 政务服务热线提供英、俄、日、韩四种外语服务。

highlights.en: Bilingual signage is mandated at airports and major transport hubs.
highlights.cn: 机场及主要交通枢纽强制设置双语标识。

highlights.en: The NIA also runs a 24-hour hotline (+86 12367) with English service.
highlights.cn: 国家移民管理局另设 24 小时热线（+86 12367），含英语服务。

tip.en: Save both numbers in your phone before departure — 12345 for daily life, 12367 for immigration/visa questions.
tip.cn: 出发前把这两个号码存进手机——12345 管日常生活，12367 管出入境/签证问题。

official_links.label_cn: 国家移民管理局服务热线

calendar.title: Three airports, direct from everywhere.
calendar.title_cn: 三大机场，全球直飞
calendar.pain: Unfamiliar with entry ports and transport.
calendar.pain_cn: 不熟悉入境口岸和交通方式。
calendar.solution: Haikou Meilan, Sanya Phoenix, Bo'ao airports — plus 144-hour transit via HK/Macau and 15-day cruise access.
calendar.solution_cn: 海口美兰、三亚凤凰、博鳌机场——另有经港/澳 144 小时过境免签及 15 天邮轮免签。

highlights.en: Three international airports: Haikou Meilan, Sanya Phoenix and Qionghai Bo'ao.
highlights.cn: 三大国际机场：海口美兰、三亚凤凰、琼海博鳌。

highlights.en: 144-hour visa-free transit via Hong Kong / Macau gives another flexible entry route.
highlights.cn: 经香港/澳门 144 小时过境免签，提供另一条灵活的入境路线。

highlights.en: 15-day visa-free entry is available for cruise-ship tour groups.
highlights.cn: 邮轮旅游团可享 15 天免签入境。

facts.cn: 经港/澳 144 小时过境免签

tip.en: If there is no direct flight from your city, fly via Hong Kong or Macau — both connect to Hainan on short hops and preserve the visa-free route.
tip.cn: 若所在城市无直飞，可经香港或澳门中转——两地到海南航程短，且不破坏免签路线。

calendar.title: Register your stay within 24 hours — or get fined.
calendar.title_cn: 24 小时内登记住宿，否则罚款
calendar.pain: Mandatory temporary residence registration is confusing and time-sensitive.
calendar.pain_cn: 临时住宿登记是强制的，流程复杂且时效性强。
calendar.solution: Our 'Maker Ambassador' walks with you to the local police station, with translation, done in one visit.
calendar.solution_cn: 我们的「创客业务员」陪你到派出所，带翻译，一次办完。

highlights.en: Foreigners must register their temporary residence within 24 hours of arrival in China.
highlights.cn: 外国人在华须在抵达后 24 小时内办理临时住宿登记。

highlights.en: Staying in a hotel auto-registers you; renting a home means you must register at the local police station yourself.
highlights.cn: 住酒店会自动登记；租房则需本人到属地派出所登记。

highlights.en: Ouwen's Maker Ambassador escorts you to the station with translation — done in one visit.
highlights.cn: 欧闻「安家大使」陪同前往，全程翻译，一次办结。

tip.en: Keep your hotel receipt or rental contract handy — it is the proof of address the police station will ask for.
tip.cn: 随身带好酒店凭证或租赁合同——这是派出所登记时要核对的住址证明。

official_links.label_cn: 海南省公安厅出入境管理局

calendar.title: Open a bank account without the headache.
calendar.title_cn: 无痛开设银行账户
calendar.pain: Local bank account requires work proof, address proof — a maze.
calendar.pain_cn: 本地开户需工作证明、地址证明，像走迷宫。
calendar.solution: 'Life Concierge' prepares documents, escorts you to partner banks for priority EF-account opening + linked e-CNY wallet.
calendar.solution_cn: 「生活管家」备好材料，陪你去合作银行优先开设 EF 账户并绑定数字人民币钱包。

source.name: PBOC Hainan Branch — EF Account
source.name_cn: 人民银行海南分行 — EF 账户

highlights.en: Opening a local bank account usually needs work proof and address proof — the classic maze.
highlights.cn: 本地开户通常需要工作证明与住址证明——典型的迷宫流程。

highlights.en: Hainan runs an 'EF Account' (easy/fast account) scheme for foreigners with simplified documents.
highlights.cn: 海南推出「EF 账户」（便捷账户）制度，外国人开户材料更简化。

highlights.en: Ouwen's Life Concierge prepares documents and escorts you to partner banks for priority opening + a linked e-CNY wallet.
highlights.cn: 欧闻「生活管家」备好材料，陪同到合作银行优先开户，并绑定数字人民币钱包。

facts.cn: EF 账户 = 简化开户

tip.en: Bring your passport, residence permit and a Chinese phone number — those three unlock most bank counters.
tip.cn: 带齐护照、居留许可和一个中国手机号——这三样能解锁大多数银行柜台。

official_links.label_cn: 人民银行海南省分行——EF 账户

calendar.title: SIM card & broadband — explained in English.
calendar.title_cn: 手机卡与宽带——英文讲解
calendar.pain: Can't understand mobile/broadband plans and contracts.
calendar.pain_cn: 看不懂手机/宽带套餐与合同条款。
calendar.solution: We help you choose a plan, explain the fine print, and set everything up.
calendar.solution_cn: 我们帮你选套餐、讲解细则、并完成全部开通。

source.name: Hainan FTP Intl Service Portal
source.name_cn: 海南自贸港国际服务门户

highlights.en: Mobile and broadband plans are explained in plain English — no fine-print guessing.
highlights.cn: 手机卡与宽带套餐用通俗英文讲解——不用再猜条款。

highlights.en: We help you choose the right plan for your data and home-internet needs.
highlights.cn: 我们根据你的流量与家用宽带需求帮你选对套餐。

highlights.en: From SIM activation to router setup, everything is done for you.
highlights.cn: 从办卡激活到路由器配置，全部代办。

facts.cn: 手机卡 + 宽带，全程讲解

tip.en: Get a contract plan rather than prepaid if you'll stay long — it unlocks better data rates and priority network access.
tip.cn: 长期停留建议办合约套餐而非预付卡——流量单价更优、网络优先级更高。

official_links.label_cn: 海南自贸港国际服务门户

calendar.title: The perks you're missing: duty-free, 15% tax, startup cash.
calendar.title_cn: 你错过的福利：免税、15% 税率、创业补贴
calendar.pain: Half-knowing Hainan's special policies, unable to use them.
calendar.pain_cn: 对海南特殊政策一知半解，无法真正用起来。
calendar.solution: 'Policy Expert': online knowledge base + offline salons + 1-on-1 reading of the incentives that apply to YOU.
calendar.solution_cn: 「政策专家」：线上知识库 + 线下沙龙 + 一对一解读适用于你的优惠。

highlights.en: Hainan's special incentives include duty-free shopping, a 15% tax cap and startup subsidies.
highlights.cn: 海南特殊政策含免税购物、15% 税率封顶与创业补贴。

highlights.en: Most people only half-know these — and almost no one uses them all.
highlights.cn: 多数人只知其一、鲜有人全用上。

highlights.en: Ouwen's Policy Expert gives you a 1-on-1 reading of the incentives that apply to YOUR situation.
highlights.cn: 欧闻「政策专家」一对一解读适合你的政策组合。

facts.cn: 三大福利：免税 / 15% 税率 / 补贴

tip.en: Don't self-diagnose eligibility from news headlines — one short consult often reveals a subsidy you were missing.
tip.cn: 别只靠新闻标题判断自己够不够格——一次简短咨询常能挖出你漏掉的补贴。

calendar.title: Getting around Hainan: a 5-minute crash course.
calendar.title_cn: 海南出行：5 分钟速成
calendar.pain: Unfamiliar with buses, ride-hailing, and driving rules.
calendar.pain_cn: 不熟悉公交、网约车与驾驶规则。
calendar.solution: Local transit app tutorials, temporary driving-permit assistance, partner car-rental recommendations.
calendar.solution_cn: 本地出行 APP 教程、临时驾照办理协助、合作租车推荐。

highlights.en: A 5-minute crash course covers buses, ride-hailing and driving rules.
highlights.cn: 5 分钟速成课讲清公交、网约车与驾车规则。

highlights.en: Temporary driving-permit assistance lets you hit the road fast with a foreign license.
highlights.cn: 协助办理临时驾驶许可，外国驾照也能快速上路。

highlights.en: Partner car-rental recommendations save you from tourist-price traps.
highlights.cn: 合作租车推荐，避开游客价陷阱。

tip.en: Install a local ride-hailing app and link your international card before you arrive — hailing a car gets far easier.
tip.cn: 落地前装好本地打车 App 并绑好国际卡——叫车会顺手很多。

calendar.title: Renting as a foreigner: avoid the 7 traps.
calendar.title_cn: 外国人租房：避开 7 个坑
calendar.pain: Opaque rental market, risk of fake landlords and deposit disputes.
calendar.pain_cn: 租房市场不透明，有假房东与押金纠纷风险。
calendar.solution: 'Settling Advisor' works with licensed agents, verifies property deeds, and walks you through the contract.
calendar.solution_cn: 「安居顾问」对接持牌中介、核实房产证、逐条讲解合同。

highlights.en: 7 common rental traps: fake landlords, deposit disputes, opaque clauses.
highlights.cn: 7 大租房陷阱：假房东、押金纠纷、模糊条款。

highlights.en: Ouwen's Settling Advisor works only with licensed agents and verifies property deeds.
highlights.cn: 欧闻「安家顾问」只对接持牌中介，并核验房产证。

highlights.en: Every clause of the contract is walked through with you before signing.
highlights.cn: 签约前逐条陪你过合同。

tip.en: Never pay a deposit or rent to a personal account before verifying the deed and the landlord's identity.
tip.cn: 核实房产证与房东身份前，切勿向个人账户支付押金或租金。

calendar.title: Visa renewal & extension — don't miss the deadline.
calendar.title_cn: 签证续签延期——别错过期限
calendar.pain: Complex renewal/extension timelines; risk of overstay.
calendar.pain_cn: 续签/延期流程复杂，存在逾期风险。
calendar.solution: We track your expiry dates and push proactive renewal reminders.
calendar.solution_cn: 我们跟踪你的到期日，主动推送续签提醒。

highlights.en: Renewal and extension timelines are easy to miss — and overstaying is a serious offence.
highlights.cn: 续签与延期时间点极易错过——逾期居留是严重违规。

highlights.en: Ouwen tracks every expiry date and pushes proactive renewal reminders.
highlights.cn: 欧闻跟踪每个到期日，主动推送续签提醒。

highlights.en: Start the renewal process 30 days before your current permit expires.
highlights.cn: 建议在当前许可到期前 30 天启动续签。

tip.en: Set a calendar alert the moment you receive a permit — the 30-day window closes faster than you think.
tip.cn: 拿到许可的那一刻就设好日历提醒——30 天的窗口比你想象中过得快。

calendar.title: Pay everywhere with one phone.
calendar.title_cn: 一部手机走天下
calendar.pain: Many merchants only accept WeChat/Alipay; cash is awkward.
calendar.pain_cn: 很多商户只收微信/支付宝，现金很不方便。
calendar.solution: We build a digital-yuan-friendly merchant network with in-app consumption guides & discounts.
calendar.solution_cn: 我们打造数字人民币友好商户网络，APP 内提供消费指南与优惠。

highlights.en: Most merchants accept only WeChat/Alipay — cash is awkward and change is rare.
highlights.cn: 多数商户只收微信/支付宝——现金尴尬且常找不开。

highlights.en: Ouwen builds a digital-yuan-friendly merchant network with in-app guides and discounts.
highlights.cn: 欧闻搭建数字人民币友好商户网络，附应用内消费指南与折扣。

highlights.en: One phone handles meals, transport, shopping and utilities.
highlights.cn: 一部手机搞定吃饭、出行、购物、缴费。

facts.cn: 两大支付：微信支付 + 支付宝

tip.en: Top up a small e-CNY balance as backup — a few merchants or older terminals may not take foreign cards smoothly.
tip.cn: 备一小笔数字人民币余额兜底——个别商户或老终端对外卡支持不稳定。

calendar.title: See a doctor without the language barrier.
calendar.title_cn: 看病无障碍
calendar.pain: Hard to book appointments, communicate with doctors, buy medicine.
calendar.pain_cn: 预约难、与医生沟通难、买药难。
calendar.solution: 'Health Escort': partner international clinics list, booking help, phone-interpreter medical accompaniment.
calendar.solution_cn: 「健康护航」：合作国际诊所清单、预约协助、电话翻译陪诊。

source.name: Haikou People's Hospital Intl Centre
source.name_cn: 海口市人民医院国际医疗部

highlights.en: Booking appointments and talking to doctors in Chinese is the hardest part of getting care.
highlights.cn: 挂号与和医生沟通是就医最大的语言难关。

calendar.pain: Foreigners don't know the cash limits and which items must be declared at Chinese customs, risking fines or confiscation.
calendar.pain_cn: 外籍人士不清楚入境现金限额和哪些物品必须向海关申报，有被罚款或没收的风险。
calendar.solution: Ouwen's pre-flight customs checklist: declare RMB cash of ¥20,000+ or foreign currency of USD 5,000+, and know the red/green channel rules before you board.
calendar.solution_cn: 欧闻行前海关清单：人民币现金 ≥2 万或外币 ≥5000 美元须主动申报，并提前搞清红绿通道规则。

highlights.en: Declare RMB cash of ¥20,000 or more on entry/exit.
highlights.cn: 携带人民币现金 ≥2 万元须申报。

highlights.en: Declare foreign currency of USD 5,000 or more (or equivalent).
highlights.cn: 携带外币 ≥5000 美元（或等值）须申报。

highlights.en: Know the red (goods to declare) and green (nothing to declare) channel rules before you board.
highlights.cn: 登机前搞清红色（申报）与绿色（无申报）通道规则。

facts.cn: 人民币现金申报线 2 万元

tip.en: Undisclosed cash over the limit risks fines or confiscation — declare at the red channel and keep the receipt.
tip.cn: 超额现金不申报有罚款或没收风险——走红色通道主动申报并保留凭证。

calendar.title: Z visa in hand? Swap it for a residence permit within 30 days.
calendar.title_cn: Z 签已到手？30 天内换成居留许可
calendar.pain: You entered on a Z visa but don't realize it must be converted into a residence permit within 30 days of entry — miss the window and you're overstaying.
calendar.pain_cn: 你持 Z 签入境，却不知道必须在入境 30 天内把它换成居留许可——错过期限就属于逾期滞留。
calendar.solution: Ouwen books your Exit-Entry Administration appointment, prepares the full dossier (work permit card, medical record, housing registration), and gets your residence permit issued before the deadline.
calendar.solution_cn: 欧闻帮你预约出入境管理局、备齐全套材料（工作许可证、体检记录、住宿登记），在期限内办妥居留许可。

highlights.en: A Z visa must be converted into a residence permit within 30 days of entry.
highlights.cn: Z 字签证须在入境后 30 天内换发居留许可。

highlights.en: Miss the 30-day window and you are effectively overstaying.
highlights.cn: 错过 30 天窗口，就相当于逾期居留。

highlights.en: Ouwen books your Exit-Entry Administration appointment and prepares the full dossier.
highlights.cn: 欧闻代约出入境管理局，备齐完整材料。

facts.en: Dossier: work permit card + medical record + housing registration
facts.cn: 材料：工作许可卡 + 体检记录 + 住宿登记

tip.en: Book your appointment the week you land — popular offices fill up fast and the clock is already running.
tip.cn: 落地当周就约号——热门窗口号源紧张，而倒计时早已开始。

calendar.title: Ride the island-loop high-speed rail: 3 hours, 653 km, one ticket.
calendar.title_cn: 坐环岛高铁：3 小时、653 公里、一张票
calendar.pain: Foreigners don't realize Hainan has a high-speed rail loop linking Haikou, Sanya and every major city, so they overpay for taxis or flights just to cross the island.
calendar.pain_cn: 外籍人士不知道海南有一条环岛高铁连接海口、三亚等各大城市，结果只能花高价打车或坐飞机跨岛。
calendar.solution: Ouwen's transport guide shows you how to book with a foreign passport, read the Haikou East / Sanya route maps and stations, and pick which stretch of the island to explore on a day trip.
calendar.solution_cn: 欧闻出行指南教你用外国护照购票、看懂海口东/三亚等线路与站点，并推荐适合一日游的环岛路段。

highlights.en: Hainan has a high-speed rail loop linking Haikou, Sanya and every major city.
highlights.cn: 海南环岛高铁串起海口、三亚及各主要城市。

highlights.en: The full loop is about 653 km and roughly 3 hours — one ticket goes a long way.
highlights.cn: 环岛全程约 653 公里、约 3 小时——一张票走很长的路。

highlights.en: Book with a foreign passport via the official app or station counters.
highlights.cn: 用外国护照可通过官方 App 或车站窗口购票。

tip.en: Skip taxis and flights for island hops — the high-speed rail is usually faster, cheaper and smoother.
tip.cn: 岛内出行别选打车或飞机——高铁通常更快、更便宜、更平稳。

calendar.title: Get certified as a Hainan high-level talent (A/B/C) — and unlock real perks
calendar.title_cn: 认定海南高层次人才（A/B/C 类）——解锁真福利
calendar.pain: Foreign professionals don't know they can be certified as Hainan high-level talent, so they miss out on housing subsidies, tax incentives, and school-priority perks.
calendar.pain_cn: 外籍专业人士不知道自己能认定海南高层次人才，白白错过住房补贴、税收优惠和子女入学优先等福利。
calendar.solution: Ouwen checks your qualifications against the A/B/C classification catalogue, files the talent certification for you, and helps you claim the matching housing, tax and education benefits.
calendar.solution_cn: 欧闻对照 A/B/C 分类目录核查你的资质、代办人才认定，并协助申领对应的住房、税收与教育福利。

source.name: Hainan FTP International Service Portal — Talent
source.name_cn: 海南自贸港国际服务门户 — 人才

highlights.en: Hainan certifies high-level talent in A/B/C classes with real perks.
highlights.cn: 海南按 A/B/C 类认定高层次人才，附真金白银的福利。

highlights.en: Perks include housing subsidies, tax incentives and school-priority access.
highlights.cn: 福利含住房补贴、税收优惠与子女入学优先。

highlights.en: Owen checks your qualifications against the catalogue and files the certification.
highlights.cn: 欧闻对照目录核查资质，并代你申报认定。

tip.en: Talent certification is the gateway that unlocks the 15% tax rate and school priority — apply for it as soon as you qualify.
tip.cn: 人才认定是解锁 15% 税率与入学优先的钥匙——一旦够格就尽早申报。

official_links.label_en: Hainan FTP International Service Portal — Talent
official_links.label_cn: 海南自贸港国际服务门户——人才

calendar.title: Bringing your pet to Hainan? Start the paperwork 30+ days early.
calendar.title_cn: 带宠物来海南？至少提前 30 天备材料
calendar.pain: Foreigners relocating with a dog or cat don't realize China requires an ISO microchip, an up-to-date rabies vaccine, and an official health certificate, plus entry through a designated port — or their pet gets quarantined.
calendar.pain_cn: 带猫狗来琼的外籍人士不知道中国要求 ISO 芯片、有效狂犬疫苗和官方健康证明，且须从指定口岸入境——否则宠物会被隔离。
calendar.solution: Ouwen's pet-arrival checklist maps every requirement by origin country, tells you which ports accept pets, and prepares the full certificate pack before you fly.
calendar.solution_cn: 欧闻宠物入境清单按来源国逐项列出要求、告知哪些口岸可携宠入境，并在起飞前备齐全套证明。

highlights.en: China requires an ISO-standard microchip, an up-to-date rabies vaccine and an official health certificate.
highlights.cn: 中国要求 ISO 标准芯片、有效狂犬疫苗和官方健康证明。

highlights.en: Pets must enter through a designated port — or face quarantine.
highlights.cn: 宠物须从指定口岸入境——否则会被隔离。

highlights.en: Start the paperwork 30+ days early; requirements vary by origin country.
highlights.cn: 至少提前 30 天备材料；不同来源国要求不同。

facts.en: 3 core requirements: ISO chip + rabies shot + health certificate
facts.cn: 三大要件：ISO 芯片 + 狂犬疫苗 + 健康证明

tip.en: Check which ports accept pets for your route — not every port clears animals, and flying into the wrong one can mean quarantine.
tip.cn: 务必确认你的航线经停哪些口岸可携宠入境——并非所有口岸都清关宠物，飞错口岸可能面临隔离。

calendar.title: Your employment injury insurance starts on Day 1 — even during probation.
calendar.title_cn: 工伤保险入职第一天就生效——试用期也算
calendar.pain: Foreigners working in Hainan don't know they are entitled to social insurance from their first work day, and assume their employer handles everything automatically.
calendar.pain_cn: 在海南工作的外籍人士不知道从第一天起就享有社会保险，以为雇主会自动办理。
calendar.solution: Ouwen walks you through Hainan's five-insurance system (pension, medical, unemployment, work injury, maternity), your employer's 30-day registration obligation, and how to verify your coverage online.
calendar.solution_cn: 欧闻带你了解海南五险（养老、医疗、失业、工伤、生育）体系、雇主的30天参保义务，以及如何在线核查自己的参保状态。

source.name: Hainan Provincial Human Resources and Social Security Department
source.name_cn: 海南省人力资源和社会保障厅

highlights.en: Social insurance coverage starts from your first work day — even during probation.
highlights.cn: 社保自入职第一天起生效——试用期也不例外。

highlights.en: Your employer must register you within 30 days of employment.
highlights.cn: 用人单位须在用工之日起 30 日内为你参保登记。

highlights.en: Hainan's five-insurance system: pension, medical, unemployment, work injury, maternity.
highlights.cn: 海南五险：养老、医疗、失业、工伤、生育。

facts.en: 5 insurances: pension / medical / unemployment / injury / maternity
facts.cn: 五险：养老/医疗/失业/工伤/生育
用人单位 30 日登记义务

tip.en: Verify your coverage online shortly after starting — don't just assume your employer handled it.
tip.cn: 入职后不久就上网核查自己的参保状态——别默认公司已经办好。

official_links.label_cn: 海南省人力资源和社会保障厅

calendar.title: Garbage sorting in Hainan: the 4 bins you must learn
calendar.title_cn: 海南垃圾分类：必须学会的 4 类垃圾桶
calendar.pain: Haikou, Sanya and other cities now enforce mandatory household waste sorting with fines, but most foreigners don't know the four categories (recyclable, kitchen, hazardous, other) or their district's rules.
calendar.pain_cn: 海口、三亚等城市已强制实行生活垃圾分类并设有罚款，但多数外籍人士不清楚四分类（可回收、厨余、有害、其他）和所在区的规定。
calendar.solution: Ouwen's bilingual sorting chart plus a neighborhood guide tells you which bin each item belongs in, the collection schedule, and your district's specific rules — so you never risk a fine.
calendar.solution_cn: 欧闻双语分类表 + 社区指南告诉你每样垃圾该扔哪个桶、收运时间以及你所在区的具体规定——从此不再担心被罚款。

highlights.en: Haikou, Sanya and other cities enforce mandatory waste sorting with fines.
highlights.cn: 海口、三亚等城市强制垃圾分类，违规有罚款。

highlights.en: The four categories: recyclable, kitchen, hazardous and other.
highlights.cn: 四类：可回收物、厨余垃圾、有害垃圾、其他垃圾。

highlights.en: Ouwen's bilingual sorting chart plus a neighbourhood guide removes the guesswork.
highlights.cn: 欧闻双语分类图 + 社区指南，让分类不再靠猜。

facts.cn: 四类桶：可回收/厨余/有害/其他

tip.en: Batteries and light bulbs are hazardous, not 'other' — that's the most common mistake that earns a fine.
tip.cn: 电池、灯泡属有害垃圾而非「其他」——这是最容易吃罚单的错误。

calendar.title: Annual tax settlement: don't miss the March–June filing window
calendar.title_cn: 个税年度汇算：别错过 3–6 月申报期
calendar.pain: Foreign residents often don't realize they must file an annual individual income tax reconciliation in China — or that it's the same window where Hainan's 15% incentive gets applied.
calendar.pain_cn: 外籍居民往往不知道中国需要办理个税年度汇算，更不知道这正是海南 15% 优惠落地的同一窗口。
calendar.solution: Ouwen reminds you every March, determines your resident or non-resident tax status, and helps you complete the annual settlement — applying the 15% Hainan rate where you qualify.
calendar.solution_cn: 欧闻每年 3 月提醒你、判定居民/非居民纳税身份，并协助完成年度汇算——符合条件时同步享受海南 15% 优惠税率。

highlights.en: Foreign residents must file an annual individual income tax reconciliation in China.
highlights.cn: 外籍居民须在中国办理个税年度汇算。

highlights.en: The March–June window is also when Hainan's 15% incentive gets applied.
highlights.cn: 3–6 月窗口期也正是海南 15% 优惠落实的时段。

highlights.en: Owen reminds you every March and completes the settlement for you.
highlights.cn: 欧闻每年 3 月提醒，并代你完成汇算。

tip.en: Mark March in your calendar every year — missing the annual settlement can mean penalties and a lost 15% refund.
tip.cn: 每年在日历上标记 3 月——错过年度汇算可能面临滞纳金，还错失 15% 退税。

calendar.title: Book smart: the new flight-tax refund most visitors miss.
calendar.title_cn: 聪明购票：大多数访客不知道的国际航班离境退税
calendar.pain: Foreign travellers don't know they can claim back value-added tax on plane tickets purchased in China — and that Hainan has its own additional refund scheme for island-bound flights.
calendar.pain_cn: 外籍旅客不知道可以申请中国境内购买的机票增值税退税，也不知道海南还有针对离岛航班的地方退税政策。
calendar.solution: Ouwen walks you through the CNY 100k VAT-refund cap for international flights, Hainan's island-departure tax-refund eligibility, and which airlines participate.
calendar.solution_cn: 欧闻带你了解国际航班最高 10 万元增值税退税额度、海南离岛退税条件，以及参与航司名单。

highlights.en: International flight tickets bought in China are eligible for VAT refund (up to a CNY 100,000 cap).
highlights.cn: 在中国境内购买的国际机票可申请增值税退税（上限 10 万元）。

highlights.en: Hainan adds its own island-departure tax-refund scheme for eligible flights.
highlights.cn: 海南另有离岛退税政策，适用于符合条件的航班。

highlights.en: Not all airlines participate — check before booking.
highlights.cn: 并非所有航司都参与——购票前先确认。

facts.en: CNY 100,000 VAT-refund cap for international flights
facts.cn: 国际航班增值税退税上限 10 万元

tip.en: Keep your e-ticket itinerary/receipt and boarding pass — both are usually required to claim the refund.
tip.cn: 保留电子行程单和登机牌——申请退税时通常两者都需要。

calendar.title: Moved in? Set up water, power, gas & internet the right way.
calendar.title_cn: 搬进新家？正确开通水电气与网络
calendar.pain: After signing a lease, most foreigners don't know how to transfer utility accounts into their name, read the tiered electricity bills, or pay without a local bank card.
calendar.pain_cn: 签完租房合同后，多数外籍人士不知道如何把水电燃气账户过户到自己名下、看懂阶梯电价账单，或没有本地银行卡该如何缴费。
calendar.solution: Ouwen transfers your water, power, gas and broadband accounts, explains Hainan's tiered electricity pricing, and sets up WeChat/Alipay auto-pay so every bill is settled on time.
calendar.solution_cn: 欧闻帮你过户水、电、燃气和宽带账户，讲解海南阶梯电价，并开通微信/支付宝自动缴费，让每张账单都按时结清。

source.name: Hainan Provincial Government — Living Services
source.name_cn: 海南省政府网 — 生活服务

highlights.en: After signing a lease, transfer water, power, gas and broadband into your name.
highlights.cn: 签完租约后，把水、电、气、宽带过户到自己名下。

highlights.en: Hainan uses tiered electricity pricing — the more you use, the higher the rate.
highlights.cn: 海南实行阶梯电价——用得越多，单价越高。

highlights.en: Set up WeChat/Alipay auto-pay so every bill settles on time.
highlights.cn: 开通微信/支付宝自动缴费，账单准时结清。

tip.en: Ask the landlord for the last bill before you move in — it confirms the account numbers and avoids paying the previous tenant's arrears.
tip.cn: 入住前向房东要上一期账单——既能确认户号，又能避免替前任住户补缴欠费。

calendar.title: Save these numbers now: 110, 119, 120 & 12345
calendar.pain: In an emergency, most foreigners don't know China's emergency numbers and freeze trying to explain the situation to a dispatcher in Chinese.
calendar.pain_cn: 遇到紧急情况时，多数外籍人士不知道中国的紧急号码，也难以用中文向接线员说清情况。
calendar.solution: Ouwen gives you a bilingual emergency card — police 110, fire 119, ambulance 120, plus the 12345 government hotline with English service — to keep on your phone's home screen.
calendar.solution_cn: 欧闻送你一张双语应急卡——报警 110、火警 119、急救 120，以及提供英语服务的 12345 政务服务热线——存到手机主屏备用。

source.name: Hainan Provincial Government — 12345 Service Hotline
source.name_cn: 海南省政府 — 12345 政务服务热线

highlights.en: China's emergency numbers: police 110, fire 119, ambulance 120.
highlights.cn: 中国应急电话：报警 110、火警 119、急救 120。

highlights.en: 12345 is the government service hotline with English support.
highlights.cn: 12345 是政务服务热线，含英语服务。

highlights.en: Ouwen gives you a bilingual emergency card to keep on your phone's home screen.
highlights.cn: 欧闻提供双语应急卡，放在手机首屏随时取用。

tip.en: Save these as home-screen widgets or lock-screen notes — in an emergency you won't have time to search.
tip.cn: 把这些做成首屏小组件或锁屏便签——紧急关头没时间翻找。

official_links.label_cn: 海南省政府——12345 服务热线

calendar.title: Zero-tariff inputs + 30% value-add rule: Hainan's factory bonus
calendar.title_cn: 零关税原料 + 加工增值 30% 规则：海南制造红利
calendar.pain: Entrepreneurs don't know Hainan Free Trade Port lets manufacturers import machinery and raw materials duty-free, and that products with over 30% local value-add re-enter the domestic market tariff-free.
calendar.pain_cn: 创业者不知道海南自贸港允许制造企业零关税进口设备与原料，且加工增值超 30% 的产品可免税销往内地市场。
calendar.solution: Ouwen checks your business against the zero-tariff positive list, confirms the 30% value-add calculation, and files the required customs recordation so you import duty-free from day one.
calendar.solution_cn: 欧闻对照零关税正面清单核查你的业务、确认 30% 增值额计算，并代办海关备案，让你从第一天起就零关税进口。

highlights.en: Hainan Free Trade Port lets manufacturers import machinery and raw materials duty-free.
highlights.cn: 海南自贸港允许制造企业免税进口机器设备与原材料。

highlights.en: Products with over 30% local value-add re-enter the domestic market tariff-free.
highlights.cn: 加工增值超过 30% 的产品，可免税销往内地市场。

highlights.en: Owen checks your business against the zero-tariff positive list and files the customs recordation.
highlights.cn: 欧闻对照零关税正面清单核查，并代办海关备案。

tip.en: The 30% value-add calculation is technical — get it right at the customs recordation stage, not during an audit.
tip.cn: 30% 增值的计算很专业——要在海关备案阶段就做对，而不是等稽查时才补救。

calendar.title: Fill out your China entry health declaration before you board
calendar.title_cn: 登机前填好中国入境健康申报
calendar.pain: Many travellers arrive at the Hainan border without completing China's mandatory entry health declaration, causing delays at the checkpoint or being pulled aside to fill it out on the spot.
calendar.pain_cn: 不少旅客抵达海南口岸才发现没填中国入境健康申报，在边检排队或被要求现场补填。
calendar.solution: Ouwen's pre-flight checklist shows you how to complete the health declaration via the 'Customs Pocket Declaration' WeChat mini-program (or paper form), save the QR code, and present it on arrival.
calendar.solution_cn: 欧闻行前清单教你通过「海关旅客指尖服务」微信小程序（或纸质版）完成健康申报、保存二维码并在入境时出示。

highlights.en: Complete China's entry health declaration via the 'Customs Pocket Declaration' (海关旅客指尖服务) WeChat mini-program before you board.
highlights.cn: 登机前通过「海关旅客指尖服务」微信小程序完成入境健康申报。

highlights.en: Alternatively use the web portal htdecl.chinaport.gov.cn or the China Customs App.
highlights.cn: 也可通过网页 htdecl.chinaport.gov.cn 或中国海关 App 办理。

highlights.en: Save the QR code and present it at customs on arrival.
highlights.cn: 保存二维码，入境时向海关出示。

facts.en: 3 ways to declare: WeChat mini-program / web / App
facts.cn: 3 种申报方式：小程序 / 网页 / App

tip.en: Do it 24 hours before arrival and screenshot the QR code — airport WiFi can be slow, and a saved code gets you through faster.
tip.cn: 抵达前 24 小时内填写并截图保存二维码——机场 WiFi 可能很慢，存好的码能让你更快通关。
